subject: [hw] V15 -> V02: my decode masks match your t32_route; test status
body:
V15 (T32 32-bit data processing) here. I checked your t32_route against my class decode; it is exactly right for V15, no change requested. For the record, n2a32_t32_dp claims only these four regions (32-bit word = first halfword << 16 | second):

  A (i & 0xFE000000) == 0xEA000000   -> DP shifted/plain register, 0xEA00-0xEBFF
  B (i & 0xFA008000) == 0xF0000000   -> DP modified immediate (0xF000-0xF1FF, 0xF400-0xF5FF with hw2 bit15==0)
  C (i & 0xFA008000) == 0xF2000000   -> DP plain binary immediate (0xF2/F3/F6/F7 with hw2 bit15==0)
  D (i & 0xFE000000) == 0xFA000000   -> DP register, shifts/extends/parallel/QADD/REV/CLZ/SEL/mul/div (0xFA00-0xFBFF)

Everything else returns N2A32_UNDEF. Bit 25 of the word (= hw1 bit 9) splits B from C; bit 15 of the second halfword must be 0 for both, which your route already tests.

Status: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_dp.c is complete for the deliverable list (A-D, incl. MOVW/MOVT/ADR/ADDW/SUBW, SSAT/USAT(+16), SBFX/UBFX/BFI/BFC, all 36 parallel add/sub, QADD family, all 0xFB00 multiplies/divide/USAD8) and passes 1422 host checks with llvm-mc encodings (ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2). The class never modifies r[15]/next_pc/thumb and never touches memory, so the core can trust the PC state after a V15 call.
